The '''2-1 BXS combat-trauma surgical droid''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. A 2-1 BXS combat-trauma surgical droid operated on [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]]'s stomach wound after he was [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|attacked]].
